findings.root_cause: Community recommendations sorted primarily by average score and only used popularity as a tie breaker.
findings.resolution: Introduce a deterministic hot score combining logarithmic popularity, verified quality, positivity and freshness.

findings.root_cause: Personalized shelves requested sort=rating, which did not explicitly represent hotness.
findings.resolution: Add and use sort=hot while preserving genre constraints and history exclusions.

findings.root_cause: The resumable snapshot pipeline indexes public metadata while protected chapter bodies are intentionally on-demand.
findings.resolution: Run the existing resumable catalog pipeline; only archive content with an explicit rights basis or public-domain status.
